institutions.name: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
institutions.history: CUHK is a highly esteemed, forward-looking comprehensive research university, recognized for excellence both regionally and globally. Founded in 1963, it is the second oldest university in Hong Kong. What sets CUHK apart are its deep roots in Chinese culture, its emphasis on bilingualism and multiculturalism, and a unique college system. The University’s founding philosophy is to combine tradition with modernity and to bring together China and the West
